body:
This PR adds a playable, no-build 2.5D tower defense game 'Typhoon Tycoon' under /games/typhoon-tycoon.

Summary:
- Three.js scene with textured ground, background, lighting and visible enemy path
- Enemy waves that follow waypoints
- Tower placement, automatic targeting, projectiles, health, rewards, lives and UI
- Uses original assets (map, typhoon sprite, bg, sound) from the TyphoonTycoon repo to retain thematic fidelity
- No build step: runs by opening index.html or via GitHub Pages

Files added/changed:
- /games/typhoon-tycoon/index.html, main.js, style.css, README.md
- /games/typhoon-tycoon/assets/* (map, typhoon, bg, sound, warning, map-hitarea)

Testing notes:
- Tested locally via http-server, scene renders and assets load from assets/
- Start the game using START GAME, click to place towers, waves spawn and towers attack

Original source assets used from: https://github.com/jasonycw/TyphoonTycoon (images/sounds)

Please review and merge into master when ready.
